channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Reddit Users Report Retatrutide Side Effects Not Seen in Trials
item.description: Social media reports of retatrutide side effects differ from clinical trial data, though a causal link remains unestablished, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: NHS Diagnoses May Reach Fewer Than One in 15 South London Teens
item.description: Fewer than one in 15 young people in south London estimated to have a mental health disorder may have received an NHS diagnosis.

item.title: STING Pathway Identified as Potential Target for Skeletal Aging Treatment
item.description: Bone loss with age, known as osteoporosis, results from changes in bone marrow cells, and a new pathway may offer a treatment target.

item.title: Parents of Medically Complex Children Often Resolve Safety Issues Alone
item.description: About 1 in 20 U.S. children under 18 are medically complex, with conditions such as cerebral palsy, and their parents frequently handle safety problems themselves.
